metadata.title: Branch Obstructions for Area-Minimizing Currents and Flat Critical Points of Weakly-Conformal Maps
metadata.abstract: We study two problems motivated by the local geometry of conformal $\phi$-curves. First, let $T$ be a $k$-dimensional locally area-minimizing integral current in Euclidean space, with $k\geq3$, codimension at least two, no boundary, and a locally conformally flat induced metric on $\operatorname{reg} T$. We prove the following branch obstruction: at any rapid-decay branch point whose planar frequency differs from $2$, every nonzero cyclic component of every cylindrical normalized tangent function has repetition multiplicity at least two. Consequently, the nonintegral-frequency points of densities $2$ and $3$ in the rapid-decay branch set have Hausdorff dimension at most $k-3$. On the full branch set, they have zero $\mathcal H^{k-2}$ measure. These conclusions apply to Euclidean image currents of conformal $\phi$-curves with locally conformally flat domains, provided the image currents satisfy the stated hypotheses. Second, for $C^j$ weakly-conformal maps between smooth Riemannian manifolds, with domain dimension $k\geq3$ and $j\geq2$, we prove that all derivatives of orders $1$ through $j$ vanish at every critical point. As a consequence, for smooth weakly-conformal maps with connected domain, we establish a curvature condition under which the map is constant or has no critical points. The flatness and continuation results apply in particular to conformal $\phi$-curves with the corresponding regularity and curvature assumptions. Finally, we examine the Borůvka cone, which illustrates the role of regularity and the distinction between critical points and branch points.

analysis.progressType: 共形平坦极小流的分支重数障碍与条件性临界点延拓
analysis.workSummary: 对欧氏空间中k≥3、余维m≥2、局部面积极小且内部无边界的整流T，假设reg T诱导度量局部共形平坦。定理3.9在rapid-decay密度q分支点、planar frequency ν≠2时，限制每个cylindrical normalized tangent function的每个非零循环分量重复重数m_j≥2，若ν=p₀/q₀则2q₀J≤q−m₀；k≥4时逐点结论也涵盖ν=2。密度2/3且非整数频率的rapid-decay分支点维数≤k−3，在全分支集仅证明H^(k−2)零测度。另对任意光滑域/靶度量、n≥k≥3的C^j弱共形映射（j≥2），临界点1至j阶导数全消失，光滑情形为Taylor-flat。
techniques: 多值切函数、循环分量与频率分层
单重分量到精确光滑sheet的提取
Allard正则性及多值图导数收敛
齐次弱共形多项式的球谐刚性
Yamabe方程与逆距离平方势的屏障
analysis.breakthrough: 局部共形平坦通过三维Cotton及高维Weyl曲率排除单重非零循环分量，与Krummel–Wickramasekera分层结合得上述维数限制。对于光滑连通域弱共形映射，若临界集Z非空且每个紧集上λ²Scal_(u*h)≥−C/dist(·,Z)²，则映射常值；局部有界dist(·,Z)λ|II|足以保证该曲率界。Borůvka锥的C^(2,√6−2)参数化表明不能把这里的光滑条件降到该有限正则性。
analysis.limitations: 流分支定理不等于无分支定理：逐点部分要求rapid-decay及圆柱切函数，三维ν=2例外保留；全分支集的H^(k−2)零测度不能升级为维数≤k−3，更不表示空集/离散。任意φ曲线不自动给合格像流，须核实像流存在、局部有限质量、整重数及无边界；仅极小性不足代替面积极小。Taylor-flat本身不排除光滑高余维映射临界点；无曲率附加条件的非恒定光滑高余维问题正文仍列开放。Borůvka例只有C^(2,√6−2)、非C³，顶点切锥非平面，所以是映射临界点却不是本文定义的流分支点。曲背景第5节仅给1<ν<2且满足指定图展开的局部延伸，不是一般曲背景的完整流定理。已读PDF第1–7、10、28–32、53–66页，渲染第4、6、31、65页核对重数、曲率条件、Cotton首项和正则性反例；未独立逐行核验第6节全部分量分离/精确sheet提取或外部切函数理论。外部依赖包括Krummel–Wickramasekera的切函数与分层、Allard正则性、Pérez Fernández–Pérez多项式刚性及Baird–Wood的Taylor/Yamabe框架。
